Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class PendingRegistration

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.PendingRegistration
@Entity public class PendingRegistration extends Object
Entity representing a pending user registration that awaits confirmation. This entity stores temporary registration data including confirmation tokens and expiration dates for email verification during the user registration process.
